title: How Trillion works · An Anatomy illustration
description: An interactive physical metaphor for how Trillion finds the needle mover, acts with your AI and checks the result.
headline: Trillion finds the needle mover.

phases.title: Start with your life.
phases.copy: Your pursuits, conversations and connected sources give your AI the context to understand what matters. The cards in the tray represent those inputs.

phases.title: Find the needle mover.
phases.copy: Out of the possible actions, identify the one most likely to move your pursuit forward. The picker carries one lit card: attention becomes a specific piece of work.

phases.title: Bring the right tools.
phases.copy: Trillion connects your AI with the capabilities the job needs. Tools, skills and workflows can be installed, combined or built. The interchangeable modules stand for those capabilities.

phases.title: Check the actual result.
phases.copy: A started task is not a finished outcome. Read back what changed, handle what still stands in the way, and keep going. The inspection station stands for that check.

example.title: Find a new client
steps: Understand the offer, past conversations and where a useful opportunity exists.
Choose a relevant introduction as the action that could unlock a client conversation.
Prepare the introduction and use the connected tools to carry out the authorized work.
Check whether the introduction happened and whether the conversation advanced. If it did not, resolve the real blocker.

sections.title: Your AI. More capable.
sections.copy: Connect the AI you want to work with. Trillion gives it shared context and a place to use tools, keep work and continue across conversations.

sections.title: Capabilities that grow.
sections.copy: The marketplace brings in skills, tools and workflows. Anatomy is one example: a reusable skill for making complex ideas visible.

sections.title: Work that goes somewhere.
sections.copy: The pursuit is the point. Trillion connects understanding, action and checking so the work keeps moving toward the change you want.
